The fourth global coral bleaching event was confirmed on April 15, 2024. But the satellite record of bleaching-level heat stress covers a longer period: from January 2023 through September 2025.

Across that window, the heat-stress footprint reached roughly 84.4% of global reef area—up from 68.2% during the 2014–2017 event. Mass bleaching was documented in at least 83 countries and territories.

That makes this event record-setting by measured heat-stress exposure. It does not mean that every exposed reef bleached or died.
